'''Star Chamber''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] that served as a headquarters for the intergalactic conspiracy organization [[Star Cabal]]. In [[3640 BBY]], [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Cipher Agent]] [[Cipher Nine|Nine]] [[Mission to the Star Chamber|infiltrated]] the space station and eliminated the leaders of Star Cabal.<ref name="TOR" />
